definitions.explanation: Describes someone who endures hardship or frustration without giving up. Emphasizes inner strength and the ability to keep going over a long period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}く⟦{待|ま}っていれば→待つ：00469_matsu⟧、⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: If you wait patiently, an opportunity will surely come.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}く⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: The teacher patiently kept answering the students' questions.

notes:
USAGE:
{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い combines ⟦{忍耐|にんたい}→忍耐：05212_nintai⟧ (endurance, patience) with ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong). It describes a deeper, more sustained patience than simply ⟦{我慢強|がまんづよ}い→我慢強い：07164_gamanzuyoi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忍耐強|にんたいづよ}く⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait patiently)
- {忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (patient personality)
- {忍耐強|にんたいづよ}く⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ (to work on something perseveringly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{我慢強|がまんづよ}い→我慢強い：07164_gamanzuyoi⟧ focuses on tolerating discomfort or annoyance, while {忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い emphasizes long-term endurance and persistence toward a goal.
